description: Identical catalog to failure-handler-missing-template-key with exactly one difference: the INSTANCE failure handler is TranslationFailureHandler.throwException(). Serves 'callback exceptions' by pinning where the throw surfaces (DefaultStrings.java:761-763 puts the THROW_EXCEPTION arm inside getResult, and get() is only getResult(...).getTranslation() at DefaultStrings.java:643), and pairs with per-call overrides that must replace it wholesale rather than compose with it.
